# License text provenance

Fallback texts for crates whose published archive has no top-level license file:

- `alloc-stdlib.txt`: https://github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib/blob/0a81fd6928ea3b33c8cd484aa4575d50ffb98012/LICENSE
- `webview2-com.txt` (also `webview2-com-sys`): https://github.com/wravery/webview2-rs/blob/edc2caf886175ccaebe86078c9cfe1ae2a187328/LICENSE
- `webview2-com-macros.txt`: https://github.com/wravery/webview2-rs/blob/dffa41a8a46d3f5565eefbff2de57d38d399f158/LICENSE
- `MPL-2.0.txt` (`selectors`): https://www.mozilla.org/media/MPL/2.0/index.f75d2927d3c1.txt

Commit identifiers come from each locked crate's `.cargo_vcs_info.json`. Exact package source links are included in generated `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`. Dependency sources are unmodified.
